finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:20](CHANGELOG.md:20).** 380 commits, 15 worth telling users.

Four breaking, and none are labeled that way. The `v1` export route was dropped as a "refactor". Expired tokens moved 403 to 401. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. The latency histogram unit fix will move dashboards.

One feature: webhook retry with backoff. It touched `src/core/config.js`, so check for a new knob to document.

Ten perf commits are real but I left them out. Your template allows three headings only.

Next: confirm the release date. I guessed `2026-08-30`.
